import ImbalancedChen.Part3CommonPCappedMixedMoment
import ImbalancedChen.Part3SharedFirstFactorDispersion
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

/-!
# Explicit capped common-p M2 polylogarithmic majorant

SOURCE PROPOSAL ONLY -- UNCOMPILED -- HOLD -- 2026-10-22.
The first import names the future module of the independently reviewed
169-line capped-mixed proposal, SHA256
aad0b9c32ec449b054f5d59561810255ad028e05d9ebf7bccc38e67582a4b622.
This module pays the actual outsideEnergy and 3*U/Q1 exactly once.
Its constant is fixed by B before every atom, sigma, kappa and residue.
All original MediumAdmissible, positive-sigma and capped-kappa hypotheses
remain. The large shifted-order constant is never numerically expanded.
The result is a positive polylogarithmic upper majorant only: it provides
no signed-error saving, full medium estimate, spectral return or main theorem.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonPM2PolylogMajorant
noncomputable section
open ElementaryCommonPMixedMoment

def betaLogExponent (B : ℕ) : ℕ := (2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1

def m2PolylogConstant (B : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  12 * mixedMomentConstant * (2 : ℝ) ^ betaLogExponent B

theorem m2PolylogConstant_pos (B : ℕ) : 0 < m2PolylogConstant B := by
  unfold m2PolylogConstant
  exact mul_pos
    (mul_pos (by norm_num) mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.1)
    (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)

/-- A scale comparison, valid also at x=V=1 and at exponent zero later. -/
theorem log_two_mul_bounds {x V : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hV : 1 ≤ V)
    (hVx : V ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (2 * V) ∧
      1 + Real.log (2 * V) ≤ 2 * (1 + Real.log x) := by
  have hVpos : 0 < V := zero_lt_one.trans_le hV
  have hlogx : 0 ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_nonneg hx
  have hlog2 : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    linarith
  constructor
  · have h := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith : 1 ≤ 2 * V)
    linarith
  · have hlogV : Real.log V ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_le_log hVpos hVx
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hVpos.ne']
    linarith

end
end ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonPM2PolylogMajorant

namespace ImbalancedChen.Part3
noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators

/-- Cancel the sole Q1 ratio against the actual outside second moments. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_mixedMoment_with_beta_log
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
          (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 := by
  have hx : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ d.scale := zero_le_one.trans hx
  have hQpos : 0 < d.Q1 := zero_lt_one.trans_le hd.2.2.1
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ 3 * d.U / d.Q1 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)) hQpos.le
  have hL : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log d.scale := by
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hx]
  have hmain : 0 ≤ mixedMomentConstant * d.scale *
      (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.1.le hx0)
      (pow_nonneg hL _)
  have hlength : (4 * d.V * d.Q1) * (3 * d.U / d.Q1) = 12 * d.scale := by
    calc
      (4 * d.V * d.Q1) * (3 * d.U / d.Q1) =
          (4 * d.V) * ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) * d.Q1) := by ac_rfl
      _ = (4 * d.V) * (3 * d.U) := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hQpos.ne']
      _ = 12 * d.scale := by unfold MediumAtom.scale; ring
  calc
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
          ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) *
            (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale * (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073)) :=
      d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_mixedMoment hd hsigma hkappa hcap
    _ ≤ (4 * d.V * d.Q1 * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B) *
        ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) *
          (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale * (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (d.sharedFirstFactor_outside_le hd)
        (mul_nonneg hfactor hmain)
    _ = ((4 * d.V * d.Q1) * (3 * d.U / d.Q1)) *
        (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale) *
          ((1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073) := by ac_rfl
    _ = (12 * d.scale) * (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale) *
        ((1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
          (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073) := by rw [hlength]
    _ = _ := by rw [pow_two d.scale]; ac_rfl

/-- Merge the two logarithms with a constant depending only on B. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_polylog
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (131073 + betaLogExponent B) := by
  have hx : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)
  have hVx : d.V ≤ d.scale := by
    change d.V ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd.1 (zero_le_one.trans hd.2.1)
  have hlogs := log_two_mul_bounds hx hd.2.1 hVx
  have hp : (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B ≤
      (2 * (1 + Real.log d.scale)) ^ betaLogExponent B :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hlogs.1 hlogs.2 _
  have hL : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log d.scale := by
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hx]
  have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ 12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.1.le)
      (sq_nonneg _)
  calc
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
        12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 *
          (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 :=
      d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_mixedMoment_with_beta_log hd hsigma hkappa hcap
    _ ≤ 12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (2 * (1 + Real.log d.scale)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
          (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hcoefficient)
        (pow_nonneg hL _)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [mul_pow (2 : ℝ) (1 + Real.log d.scale) (betaLogExponent B),
        pow_add (1 + Real.log d.scale) 131073 (betaLogExponent B)]
      unfold m2PolylogConstant
      ac_rfl

/-- Fix C_B>0 before sigma, kappa, c0, the scale and the moving residue. -/
theorem CommonPM2PolylogMajorant.constant_pos_and_uniform (B : ℕ) :
    0 < m2PolylogConstant B ∧
      ∀ (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
        MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → 0 < sigma → 0 ≤ kappa →
          kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ)) →
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
          m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 *
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (131073 + betaLogExponent B) := by
  refine ⟨m2PolylogConstant_pos B, ?_⟩
  intro sigma kappa c0 d hd hsigma hkappa hcap
  exact d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_polylog hd hsigma hkappa hcap

end
end ImbalancedChen.Part3

def mixedMomentConstant : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (1296 * shiftedTauLogConstant kshift)

/-- D is chosen once before every scale, capped kappa and integer shift. -/
theorem mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le :
    0 < mixedMomentConstant ∧
      ∀ (x κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ κ → κ ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ)) →
        ∀ a : ℤ, |(a : ℝ)| ≤ x ^ (1 + κ) →
          mixedSum x a ≤ mixedMomentConstant * x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ 131073 := by
  have hc : 0 < 1296 * shiftedTauLogConstant kshift :=
    mul_pos (by norm_num) (shiftedTauLogConstant_pos kshift_ge_two)
  have hD : 0 < mixedMomentConstant := by
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hc
  refine ⟨hD, ?_⟩
  intro x κ hx hκ hcap a ha
  let L : ℝ := 1 + Real.log x
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by
    have h := Real.log_nonneg hx
    dsimp [L]
    linarith
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
  have hright : 0 ≤ mixedMomentConstant * x * L ^ 131073 :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hD.le hx0) (pow_nonneg hL _)
  have hright_sq : (mixedMomentConstant * x * L ^ 131073) ^ 2 =
      1296 * shiftedTauLogConstant kshift * x ^ 2 * L ^ 262146 := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← pow_mul L 131073 2,
      show (131073 : ℕ) * 2 = 262146 from rfl,
      mixedMomentConstant, Real.sq_sqrt hc.le]
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (mixedSum_nonneg x a) hright).mp
  calc
    mixedSum x a ^ 2 ≤
        1296 * shiftedTauLogConstant kshift * x ^ 2 * L ^ 262146 :=
      mixedSum_sq_le_capped hx hκ hcap a ha
    _ = (mixedMomentConstant * x * L ^ 131073) ^ 2 := hright_sq.symm

theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_mixedMoment
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
        ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) *
          (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale * (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073)) := by
  have hx : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)
  have ha : |(d.residue : ℝ)| ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + kappa) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs] using
      (hd.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 :
        (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + kappa))
  have hfold : CommonPM2FiniteFold.foldedSum d ≤
      mixedMomentConstant * d.scale * (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 := by
    rw [foldedSum_eq_mixedSum]
    exact mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.2
      d.scale kappa hx hkappa hcap d.residue ha
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ 3 * d.U / d.Q1 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1))
      (zero_le_one.trans hd.2.2.1)
  have henergy : 0 ≤ CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d := by
    unfold CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy
    exact mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
      (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
  exact (d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_finite_divisor_fold hd hsigma).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfold hfactor) henergy)

    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *

  have hgamma : (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) ≤ 2 * d.Q1 := by

    _ = _ := by ring

def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

def moment (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m * rowSum d p m ^ 2

/-- Every label is (p,m,n), not an unlabelled modulus or a pair quotient. -/
def activeLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  ((d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier) ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier).filter
    (fun z => d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight z.1.2 ≠ 0 ∧
      z.2 ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression z.1.1 z.1.2)

def labelProduct (z : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) : ℕ := z.1.2 * z.2

def foldedSum (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  ∑ v ∈ productCarrier d,
    tau v * tau (shiftDifference d v) * fourthDivisorWeight d v

/-- Original outside energies occur exactly once. -/
def outsideEnergy (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
    (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2)

theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_finite_divisor_fold
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
        ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) * CommonPM2FiniteFold.foldedSum d) := by
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (d.cleaned_commonP_moment_le_finite_divisor_fold hd hsigma)
  unfold CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy
  exact mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))

theorem log_mul (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : log (x * y) = log x + log y :=
  exp_injective <| by
    rw [exp_log_eq_abs (mul_ne_zero hx hy), exp_add, exp_log_eq_abs hx, exp_log_eq_abs hy, abs_mul]

theorem log_le_log_iff (h : 0 < x) (h₁ : 0 < y) : log x ≤ log y ↔ x ≤ y := by
  rw [← exp_le_exp, exp_log h, exp_log h₁]

@[gcongr, bound]
lemma log_le_log (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x ≤ y) : log x ≤ log y :=
  (log_le_log_iff hx (hx.trans_le hxy)).2 hxy

@[bound]
theorem log_nonneg (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ log x :=
  (log_nonneg_iff (zero_lt_one.trans_le hx)).2 hx

theorem log_le_sub_one_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : log x ≤ x - 1 := by
  rw [le_sub_iff_add_le]
  convert! add_one_le_exp (log x)
